test_title: PYST 17: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one that follows the same logic.

REAL - LRAE - RLEA

MAKE - EMKA - MEAK
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:​

REAL - LRAE - RLEA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ed342316811100a381c8cb1afa78ebb9788847336057f301c3a59d8535d719c.png] 

And,

MAKE - EMKA - MEAK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8181032d0848014756bd895a9ff177e83edfd9e298a8806771f478dc6e9db753.png] 

Similarly,

Option 1) COPE - ECPO - CEOP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd997d3fa705ae0cafa1897e81dafe0f39b78b2b469c2fadf20d4af5cb4de09b.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
